description: What is this vulnerability and does it matter now: OSV advisory records (summary, severity, affected open-source packages and fixed versions, references) for a CVE, GHSA or OSV id, whether CISA lists it as exploited in the wild (KEV: date added, remediation due date, ransomware use) and its EPSS exploit probability and percentile. Returns exploited / known / unknown with reasons. Use for patch prioritisation, vendor security questionnaires, incident triage and third-party risk reviews.
